newsitem.title: USA: Engine failure forces Tokyo-bound Northwest jet home.
newsitem.headline: Engine failure forces Tokyo-bound Northwest jet home.

text.p: A Tokyo-bound Northwest Airlines Boeing 747-200 jet with 327 people on board was forced to return to Minneapolis-St. Paul airport in Minnesota shortly after takeoff because of engine failure, airline spokeswoman Susan Maring said early on Sunday.

She said sparks were seen on one of the plane's engines five minutes after it was airborne on Saturday afternoon and the engine had to be shut down. It took 40 more minutes for the plane to dump 25,000 gallons (95,000 litres) of fuel in order to lighten its load before returning safely to the airport, she added.
The flight has been rescheduled for Sunday.
Maring said it was not clear what caused the engine to fail.
